p.src: In that episode, energy supply and logistics pressure rose faster than many households and firms could absorb. This happened even as policy liquidity moved at times to stabilize financial conditions, because the binding issue for owners was frequently real throughput. The result was a transmission lag: financing signals improved on paper before durable ownership conditions did.
